name: EPIC 251523440
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 5.7 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,086 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.91 solar masses and 5.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,825 K at its surface.
